sources.title: Iterative binary-tree traversal deterministic oracle fixture

claims.text: The preserved source only asks for a non-recursive binary-tree traversal implementation; traversal order, node/API shape, null behavior and Morris-style mutation are not preserved source constraints.
The executable fixture validates iterative preorder, inorder and single-stack postorder against recursive reference traversals on a fixed tree and 1,200 deterministic random trees.
The fixture executes all three iterative traversals on a 20,000-node right-skewed tree, demonstrating that the candidate traversal itself does not depend on recursive call depth.
